{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column
print(sales['revenue'].head())
print(sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for the QA orders
print('\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):')
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nRefunded orders:')
print(sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'])

# Check if any revenue is non-numeric
print('\nNon-numeric revenue values:')
print(sales[~sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').str.isnumeric()])"}
